exposure: Dexmedetomidine added to sufentanil intravenous PCA
outcome: Incidence of postoperative nausea and vomiting (PONV)
Time to first passage of flatus
finding: Dexmedetomidine added to sufentanil intravenous PCA significantly enhanced the analgesic effects, improved analgesic satisfaction, and had the potential benefits of reducing PONV and the recovery of intestinal functions after cesarean section.
